entry.author: Sport New Zealand Ihi Aotearoa
entry.summary:
George Bridgewater MNZM (Chair, Halberg Foundation), Justin Leydesdorff (Chair, New Zealand Rugby League), Sharleen Nathan (Chair, Sport Waikato), Rehette Stoltz (Mayor of Gisborne District Council and President of Local Government New Zealand Te Kahui Kaunihera ō Aotearoa – LGNZ). Facilitated by Jenny-May Clarkson.
After the morning’s insights, this panel looks at what comes next. Panellists will discuss what’s working, what needs to shift, and where we should put our energy to make the biggest difference.
